description: A double dark-dragon back line — both roam freely with no Fairy or Steel in the meta. Guzzlord is the safer, Sludge Bomb-equipped chipper/safe-swap while Shadow Hydreigon brings more wins against the top meta to clean up.

description: Morpeko + Mandibuzz is described as 'very very strong, there's not much that beats it.' Mandibuzz's bulk and Foul Play handle threats Morpeko struggles with (e.g. Sableye/dark spam and fighters over time) and shields the lead, while Morpeko provides Aura Wheel/Seed Bomb coverage and charge-priority pressure. Both being Dark also stacks resistances against the meta.
